extra.lines:
run: |
          {
            echo "## Inventario de la línea base vulnerable"
            echo
            echo "Referencia escaneada: \`${{ inputs.ref || github.ref_name }}\`"
            echo
            echo "| Herramienta | Hallazgos |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| Gitleaks | $(jq 'length' evidence/gitleaks.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| govulncheck | $(grep -c '^Vulnerability #' evidence/govulncheck.txt 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| gosec | $(jq '.Issues | length' evidence/gosec.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| Semgrep | $(jq '.results | length' evidence/semgrep.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| Trivy — imagen api | $(jq '[.Results[]?.Vulnerabilities // [] | length] | add // 0' evidence/trivy-api.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| Trivy — imagen web | $(jq '[.Results[]?.Vulnerabilities // [] | length] | add // 0' evidence/trivy-web.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo "| Trivy — configuración | $(jq '[.Results[]?.Misconfigurations // [] | length] | add // 0' evidence/trivy-config.json 2>/dev/null || echo '?') |"
            echo
            echo "Cada hallazgo debe acabar con su ficha en \`security/findings/\`."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
extra.message: Using variable interpolation `${{...}}` with `github` context data in a `run:` step could allow an attacker to inject their own code into the runner. This would allow them to steal secrets and code. `github` context data can have arbitrary user input and should be treated as untrusted. Instead, use an intermediate environment variable with `env:` to store the data and use the environment variable in the `run:` script. Be sure to use double-quotes the environment variable, like this: "$ENVVAR".
